reviews.text:
From Excitement to Embarrassment A Complete Letdown. I don’t normally leave reviews, but AI Arta pushed me over the edge. This app was marketed as a “realistic image generator” and photo enhancer with promises of professional-looking AI filters and headshots. What I got was a complete joke.

Let’s start with the headshots. I uploaded clear, well-lit selfies taken with a high-quality phone camera. The results? Deformed, unusable garbage. My eyes were lopsided, the skin texture looked like wax or plastic, and the teeth… my god, the teeth. I looked like I hadn’t brushed in 10 years. One photo had me looking like a meth addict in a suit. If this is “professional,” I’d hate to see their definition of casual.

And text? Forget it. Every time I tried to generate an image with a banner or simple lettering, it looked like ancient runes or alien scribbles. It’s 2025 text rendering should not be a mystery. This has been a common issue with second-rate AI apps for years now, and somehow this one didn’t even bother to improve on it.

The app’s filter system is clunky and misleading. What you see in the sample images and preview icons is not what you get. I’ve tried dozens of variations, styles, and filters, and I have never received a single image worth using for anything serious. How does an app claim to do “realistic portraits” and yet can’t get eyes and mouths right?

I paid for this app expecting decent results at the very least. Instead, I got glitchy, laughable images that I wouldn’t even post as a joke. The user interface is slow and buggy, the quality control is nonexistent, and it feels like the developers slapped a coat of glossy marketing over an unfinished product and are now charging people for beta testing.

To the developers: shame on you for misleading customers. This app is not ready for prime time, and the fact that you’re charging for results this broken feels like a scam. Fix the core rendering engine, update the text capability, and test your filters with actual human faces not whatever data set you used to train this Frankenstein engine.

Until then? Save your money. Use something else. I’ve never experienced such a steep drop from excitement to disappointment with any app, and I regret every cent I spent.
